notes: Only for a task assigned to the agent. Refused with HTTP 409 {"error":"open_children","children":[{"task","title"}]} while the task has open children or unanswered questions, with not_assigned for a task not assigned to the persona and lease_held while another session holds it. Otherwise posts the summary, ends the lease and lands provisional: the owner sees "Done by <agent>, confirm?" and confirms or keeps it open. Repeating it returns the same completion.
